options: As a proprietary NVIDIA internal tool
As a research project at UC Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab, now a widely used open-source project
As a feature built directly into PyTorch
As a commercial product with no public source code
questions.explain: vLLM began as a research project at UC Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab and is now an open-source project with contributions from many companies, including NVIDIA and AMD.

questions.q: What problem does PagedAttention solve compared to the older approach of allocating one contiguous memory block per request?
options: It eliminates the need for a KV cache entirely
It avoids wasting memory reserved for a request's maximum possible length by storing the KV cache in small, non-contiguous pages tracked by a lookup table
It moves all computation from GPU to CPU
It removes the need for tokenization
questions.explain: PagedAttention stores the KV cache in small, fixed-size pages rather than one block sized for the worst case, which lets vLLM pack far more concurrent requests into the same GPU memory.

questions.q: What inspired the design of PagedAttention?
options: Virtual memory paging in operating systems
HTTP load balancing algorithms
Relational database indexing
CPU instruction pipelining
questions.explain: PagedAttention borrows the idea of paging from operating-system virtual memory: fixed-size blocks tracked by a lookup table, rather than one large contiguous allocation.

questions.q: What does vLLM's scheduler do at every decode step, as part of continuous batching?
options: It restarts the entire batch from scratch
It checks which requests can continue, frees memory from finished requests, and admits new requests into the freed capacity
It pauses all GPU execution to run a health check
It recompiles the model
questions.explain: vLLM's continuous batching evaluates the batch composition at every single decode step, immediately reusing a finished request's freed memory pages for a newly admitted request.

questions.q: What does the --gpu-memory-utilization flag control when launching a vLLM server?
options: The maximum number of requests per second
The port the server listens on
The fraction of GPU memory vLLM is allowed to claim for model weights and the KV cache pool
The tokenizer vocabulary size
questions.explain: --gpu-memory-utilization sets what fraction of total GPU memory vLLM may claim, which determines how much room is available for the KV cache pool that continuous batching and PagedAttention rely on.
